sentence_stem: Because I was very busy this week,
correct_completion: I did not reply to your email.
full_sentence: Because I was very busy this week, I did not reply to your email.
acceptable_variants: I did not answer your email.
I did not write back to you.

options.text: so I am going to the beach tomorrow.
options.why_wrong: This gives a plan for tomorrow. It is not a result of being busy this week.

options.text: I like pizza with my friends.
options.why_wrong: This is unrelated to being busy, so it does not complete the cause and effect started by 'because'.

options.text: I will call you on Sunday.
options.why_wrong: This is a promise about the future. It does not explain the result of being busy.

options.text: I did not reply to your email.

explanation: After 'because', we give the reason. The main clause then shows the result, which must follow logically from that reason.
translation: Ponieważ byłem bardzo zajęty w tym tygodniu, nie odpowiedziałem na twojego maila.
